The value of this field should align to the Tanium Permitted Countries Policy document which is owned and maintained by the Legal team.
https://tanium.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/EmpHub-Policy%20Central/Shared%20Documents/Protecting%20Tanium%20Information%20%26%20IP/Permitted%20Countries%20Policy.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=cLJVjp
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indirect sales via partners are permitted. For purposes of this category, the country designation is based on the country where the end-user customer’s headquarters is located, not the location of the partner’s headquarters. For countries that are Partner Permitted but not Tanium Direct Sales Permitted, Tanium-provided in- country support must be pre-approved by Tanium’s Chief Customer Officer
CustomField.label: Partner Permitted
